caption: The drawing depicts a settee with a rectangular seat, straight backrest, and outwardly curved armrests. The upholstery is light beige or cream in color and features an ornate floral and vine pattern in shades of green, yellow, and hints of orange. The settee stands on six wooden cabriole legs, each ending in a claw-and-ball foot, and the legs are rendered in a reddish-brown hue. The drawing is set against an unadorned light background with visible boundary lines marking the edges of the paper. There are some faint stains and discolorations, particularly along the left edge and bottom of the paper.
title: Sofa
